input: Apply for a patent for my product idea

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Patent for My Product Idea
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to file a patent application to protect their product idea.

questions.title: What specific product or invention are you patenting?
questions.description: Understand the nature of the product idea — what it is, what it does, and what makes it unique.

questions.title: Have you already documented or prototyped this idea?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has existing documentation, sketches, prototypes, or technical specs ready.

questions.title: Which country or region do you want protection in?
questions.description: Clarify the geographic scope — domestic (e.g., USPTO), international (PCT), or specific countries.

questions.title: Have you searched for existing patents on this idea?
questions.description: Find out if the user has done any prior art search to check whether the idea is already patented.

questions.title: Are you planning to hire a patent attorney or go solo?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants professional legal help or intends to file a pro se (self-filed) application.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for filing the application?
questions.description: Identify any time pressure — such as a public disclosure date, product launch, or investor meeting — that affects urgency.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this patent process?
questions.description: Gauge the financial resources available, as costs vary widely between provisional, utility, and attorney-assisted filings.
